query:
UPDATE products
        SET
            name           = COALESCE($1, name),
            description    = COALESCE($2, description),
            price_per_unit = COALESCE($3, price_per_unit),
            unit           = COALESCE($4, unit),
            category_id    = COALESCE($5, category_id),
            updated_at     = now()
        WHERE slug      = $6
          AND farmer_id = $7
          AND is_active  = true
          AND is_deleted = false
